info.title: AstroSparkles API
info.description: REST API shared by the website and the mobile apps. All responses are { success: true, data } or { success: false, error: { code, message } }.

idToken.description: ID token from Google Sign-In on web, Android or iOS

bioEn.example: I have practised Vedic astrology for 12 years...

amount.description: Recharge amount in rupees (GST is added on top)

signature.description: razorpay_signature from Checkout. In mock mode send "mock".

topic.example: Will I get a government job this year?

text.example: Namaste, my date of birth is 15 Aug 1992.
Thank you, wishing you the best!

end.description: Local end time (HH:mm, 24h). Must be after start.

days.description: Weekly hours. Several windows per day are allowed.

start.description: Slot start exactly as returned by the slots endpoint

chartStyle.description: Chart style used in the PDF

wishes.example: Peace and good health for the family

staffRoles.description: Staff roles to grant. Replaces the current staff roles (user and astrologer roles are kept).

amount.description: Rupees. Positive credits the wallet, negative debits it.

note.example: Goodwill credit for a dropped chat
